headline: ARI @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.40 at MIA 3.91, with a projected total of 7.30. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: ARI moved -0.78 runs while MIA moved +0.33, changing the projected margin by -1.11 runs. The projected total fell -0.45, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Ryan Gusto has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Corbin Carroll, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Owen Caissie, Ildemaro Vargas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
